metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-l1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]A monitor an agent starts must actually run[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A monitor started from inside an agent survives that agent's own [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]runner teardown, and when it cannot, the failure is loud and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]immediate: `sase monitor start` refuses to return success for a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]supervisor that is not provably alive, a monitor's workspace is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never harvested out from under it, and a monitor's `--next` action [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is never silently dropped.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]monitor_supervisor_survival.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/monitor_supervisor_survival.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-l1[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-l1/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Supervisor survives its starter's teardown[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]detach[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detach: reparent the supervisor to PID 1 before `start_monitor` returns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and set its signal dispositions in the first statements it executes, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the starter's runner teardown cannot kill it during its startup window.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Monitor start is not reported until the supervisor proves it [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]is alive[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]ack[dim] · [dim][/dim]after detach[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ack: have the supervisor publish a startup acknowledgement, block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`start_monitor` on it, and turn a missing acknowledgement into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]torn-down member and a hard `MonitorError` the still-live starter agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]can act on.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A monitor's workspace claim cannot be harvested behind its [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]back[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]claim[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]claim: make the stale-RUNNING sweeper reconcile a monitor before [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]releasing its `ace-monitor` claim, and leave the claim alone when [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reconciliation fails, so a live lane's workspace is never handed to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]another agent.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The --next action survives a failed claim transfer[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]followup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after claim[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]followup: stop coupling the follow-up launch to a workspace-claim [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]transfer that can no longer succeed, and give settlement an explicit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]degraded-launch outcome instead of dropping the follow-up.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A stalled monitor lane is visible without reading done.json[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]visibility[dim] · [dim][/dim]after followup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]visibility: surface dead-on-arrival supervisors and follow-up launch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failures in the ACE Agents tree, `sase monitor list`, and notifications,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and document the new guarantees.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end exercises for the agent-started monitor path[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #5FD7AF] xsmall [/bold black on #5FD7AF]
    [#AF87FF]exercises[dim] · [dim][/dim]after detach, ack, claim, followup, visibility[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]exercises: drive a real agent-started monitor on every supported runtime[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and report what the CLI, the tree, and the follow-up agent actually did.[/#D7D7AF]
